codebase.title: G4CMP
codebase.domain: condensed-matter detector physics: phonons, charge carriers and quasiparticles in cryogenic crystals (Geant4 add-on)
codebase.fingerprint_algorithm: SHA-256 over typed sorted regular-file paths+bytes and symlink paths+safe targets

agent_authored.description: G4CMP (Geant4 Condensed Matter Physics) is a C++ add-on library for Geant4 that simulates low-temperature solid-state physics inside a Geant4 event loop: anisotropic acoustic phonons, drifting electrons and holes in Ge and Si with Luke phonon emission, energy partition of a deposit into e/h pairs and phonons, and Bogoliubov quasiparticles in superconducting films. Used by the cryogenic dark-matter (SuperCDMS) and superconducting-qubit communities. Upstream tag g4cmp-V10-01-01 = commit 558c3ce54b1c2fcc4023cf40c3c67eea93d459d5 (2026-02-24).

agent_authored.generated_vendor_third_party_notes: The complete pinned upstream tree is vendored via git archive of the tag, without .git. Third-party code inside it: library/qhull-2012.1 (unaltered Qhull, ~45k lines of C/C++, Qhull licence) and Geant4_LICENSE. Data: examples/charge/EPotFiles (125 MB of COMSOL potential meshes), examples/sensors/config (96 MB of Ramo/FET templates), CrystalMaps (216 KB of lattice config.txt), G4CMP_paper (8.5 MB of LaTeX and figures). Nothing is added beyond upstream.

approval.human_ref: Start with phonon physics only and cut off the others; charge carriers and quasiparticles can be added back later (2026-09-07).

modules.title: Phonon transport: anisotropic kinematics, scattering, downconversion, boundaries
modules.expensive_path: Per-step phonon kinematics: G4CMPPhononKinematics solves the 3x3 Christoffel eigenproblem (or reads the K-Vg lookup table) for every phonon step to map wavevector to group velocity and polarization; examples/caustics propagates 40,000,000 ballistic phonons this way (173 s single-thread as shipped) and is embarrassingly parallel across events, as are the isotope-scattering and downconversion loops of examples/phonon.
modules.rationale: One physics: acoustic phonons in an anisotropic crystal. The processes (G4PhononScattering, G4PhononDownconversion, G4CMPPhononBoundaryProcess), their rates, the kinematics tables and the two phonon examples form a closed set that needs no charge or quasiparticle code.
excluded: Luke phonon emission by drifting carriers (a charge-carrier process; its phonons use this module's transport once produced)
Polycrystalline elastic scattering in superconducting films and phonon radiation by quasiparticles (kept with the quasiparticle module because their only official tests are the validation suite)
Phonon hits digitisation by electrodes beyond G4CMPPhononElectrode (examples/sensors, not packaged)
hazards: No random seed is set anywhere; reruns are bit-identical only through Geant4's default engine state, and a port that changes the number or order of random draws breaks pointwise comparison
examples/phonon and examples/caustics open hits files in append mode; a check must start from a clean directory
caustics at the shipped 40,000,000 events takes about 3 min single-thread; the event count is the runtime knob
examples/phonon/README is stale 2012 text (describes caustic.ssv, timing.ssv, XGeBox that do not exist)
modules.purpose: One physics: acoustic phonons in an anisotropic crystal. The processes (G4PhononScattering, G4PhononDownconversion, G4CMPPhononBoundaryProcess), their rates, the kinematics tables and the two phonon examples form a closed set that needs no charge or quasiparticle code.
primary_inputs: CrystalMaps per-material config.txt elastic constants and Miller orientation
Geant4 macro: gun/gps energy, number of events, g4cmp/phononBounces, process activation
primary_outputs: phonon_hits.txt CSV (15 columns: run, event, track, particle, start energy/position/time, deposited energy, weight, end position, final time) from the electrode sensitivity
GeLookupTable.txt (189,006 rows, 19 columns) from g4cmpKVtables; nine Ge_phonon_* csv files from phononKinematics
algorithm_stages: Christoffel eigenproblem or K-Vg table lookup per step (G4CMPPhononKinematics, G4CMPPhononKinTable)
isotope scattering rate and mode mixing (G4PhononScattering, G4CMPPhononScatteringRate)
boundary reflection, absorption and electrode collection (G4CMPPhononBoundaryProcess, G4CMPPhononElectrode)
unique_responsibilities: Phonon particle types and their kinematics
Phonon scattering, downconversion and boundary processes
not_responsible_for: Luke phonon emission by drifting carriers (a charge-carrier process; its phonons use this module's transport once produced)
Polycrystalline elastic scattering in superconducting films and phonon radiation by quasiparticles (kept with the quasiparticle module because their only official tests are the validation suite)
Phonon hits digitisation by electrodes beyond G4CMPPhononElectrode (examples/sensors, not packaged)
modules.differences: Massless anisotropic phonons whose group velocity is not parallel to the wavevector; no electric field, no carriers, no superconductor gap.
evidence: examples/caustics/Caustic.mac: 40,000,000 ballistic phonons, 173 s single-thread natively

modules.title: Charge carriers: e/h drift, Luke emission, intervalley scattering, mesh fields, energy partition
entrypoints: tests/luke_dist, tests/electron_Epv, tests/testHVtransform, tests/testFanoFactor, tests/testChargeCloud, tests/g4cmpEFieldTest
modules.expensive_path: Carrier stepping: G4CMPTimeStepper, G4CMPLukeScattering and G4CMPInterValleyScattering evaluate rate integrals and Herring-Vogt valley transforms per carrier per step, and G4CMPMeshElectricField interpolates a tetrahedral COMSOL field (tens of MB of EPot files, point-location search per step); a 10 keV deposit is thousands of carriers each taking thousands of steps, independent across carriers.
modules.rationale: One physics: electrons and holes in the valley picture of Ge and Si under an electric field. Energy partition (Lindhard/NIEL yield, Fano statistics, charge cloud) is included because it is the source term that creates the carriers and its tests live in the same tests/ programs.
excluded: Transport of the Luke phonons after emission (phonon module)
Electrode readout and Ramo-potential digitisation (examples/sensors, not packaged)
Quasiparticle time stepper (a QP process despite its name)
hazards: Same seedless determinism caveat as every module: testPartition, testFanoFactor, testChargeCloud and the charge example are Monte Carlo
examples/charge has no README; drift_curve.mac needs the environment variable G4CMP_HIT_SUFFIX
g4cmpEFieldTest 3D mode needs EField3D_*.dat, which the tree does not ship; only 2D is runnable
EPot mesh files are 20 to 55 MB each and are read at startup
charge_hits.txt is opened in append mode
modules.purpose: One physics: electrons and holes in the valley picture of Ge and Si under an electric field. Energy partition (Lindhard/NIEL yield, Fano statistics, charge cloud) is included because it is the source term that creates the carriers and its tests live in the same tests/ programs.
primary_inputs: CrystalMaps per-material config.txt valley and effective-mass parameters, Luke and intervalley rate constants
examples/charge/EPotFiles COMSOL potential meshes (20 to 55 MB each) or a uniform g4cmp/voltage
hit energy, sampling threshold and lattice on the testPartition command line; energy range and material for testNRyield
primary_outputs: charge_hits.txt CSV (same 15-column format) and LukePhononEnergies from examples/charge
stdout tables: luke_dist (14 columns, 7,582 rows), electron_Epv (9 columns, 103,761 rows), testNRyield (5 yield models, 101 rows), testPartition and testFanoFactor means and sigmas
EFieldTest.txt from g4cmpEFieldTest; exit code = failure count from testHVtransform
algorithm_stages: energy partition of a deposit into e/h pairs and phonons with Lindhard/Lewin-Smith/Sarkis/Impact NIEL and Fano statistics (G4CMPEnergyPartition, G4CMP*NIEL, G4CMPFanoBinomial, G4CMPChargeCloud)
Herring-Vogt valley transforms and effective-mass kinematics (G4CMPVDriftProcess, lattice mass tensors)
time-stepped drift in the field with Luke emission and intervalley scattering rates (G4CMPTimeStepper, G4CMPLukeScattering, G4CMPInterValleyScattering, G4CMPIVRate*)
mesh electric field interpolation and equation of motion (G4CMPMeshElectricField, G4CMPFieldManager, G4CMPEqEMField)
trapping, recombination and boundary absorption (G4CMPDriftTrappingProcess, G4CMPDriftRecombinationProcess, G4CMPDriftBoundaryProcess)
unique_responsibilities: Drift electron and hole particle types
not_responsible_for: Transport of the Luke phonons after emission (phonon module)
Electrode readout and Ramo-potential digitisation (examples/sensors, not packaged)
Quasiparticle time stepper (a QP process despite its name)
modules.differences: Charged carriers in a valley effective-mass picture under an electric field; the only module with a field solver and with deterministic yield tables.
evidence: examples/charge/run.mac: 100 events x 20 pairs, 0.14 s, 4,000 hit rows
tests/electron_Epv, luke_dist, testNRyield, testHVtransform (rc 0): all under 1 s, deterministic
Luke phonons, once emitted, propagate with the phonon module's processes; the charge tests disable them via g4cmp/producePhonons 0

modules.title: Quasiparticles in superconducting films: pair breaking, recombination, phonon radiation, trapping, diffusion
entrypoints: validation/g4cmpValidation G4Macros/Validation_*.mac (nine macros of Scripts/RunValidation.sh plus Validation_Comprehensive.mac)
modules.expensive_path: Walk-on-spheres diffusion (G4CMPQPDiffusion) and the Kaplan rate evaluations (G4CMPSCPairBreakingRate, G4CMPQPRecombinationRate, G4CMPQPRadiatesPhononRate) per quasiparticle per step: Validation_QPDiffusionTOFP takes 64 s for 10,000 quasiparticles and Validation_QPRecombination is shipped at 1,000,000 events; every event is independent.
modules.rationale: One physics: Bogoliubov quasiparticles and pair-breaking phonons in thin superconducting films (Al, Nb), the newest part of the library, with its own validation suite and ROOT analysis against Kaplan theory. Polycrystalline phonon scattering in films is kept here because its only official test is in this suite.
excluded: Bulk-crystal phonon transport (phonon module) except as the pair-breaking source
hazards: Every validation and quasiparticle macro runs the OGL viewer command unconditionally; a Geant4 without OpenGL aborts the batch before beamOn, so checks must strip the vis lines
Step files are enormous (390 MB for 10,000 BoundaryTransmission events, 1.4 GB for QPDiffusionTOFP); graded output must be a reduction, not the raw file
The quasiparticle example macros abort in batch here (G4Exception UIMAN0123, command rejected) and produced no output; cause not yet identified
Validation_Comprehensive (1,000 events) and Validation_QPPhononRadiation (100,000) exceed 3 min at shipped size; QPRecombination (1,000,000) was not run
Seedless Monte Carlo as in every module
Only single-threaded operation is supported (README of examples/quasiparticle)
modules.purpose: One physics: Bogoliubov quasiparticles and pair-breaking phonons in thin superconducting films (Al, Nb), the newest part of the library, with its own validation suite and ROOT analysis against Kaplan theory. Polycrystalline phonon scattering in films is kept here because its only official test is in this suite.
primary_inputs: CrystalMaps Al and Nb config.txt superconductor parameters (gap, tau0_qp, tau0_ph, diffusion constant, trapping time)
validation/G4Macros/Validation_*.mac (geometry id, step file name, primary spectrum, process activation, event count)
primary_outputs: Validation_<test>.txt step file (18 space-separated columns at 14 digits: run, event, track, particle, pre/post position, time, energy, kinetic energy, reflections, process name); reduced offline by validation/AnalysisTools/ValidationAnalysis.cc (ROOT) into lifetime fits
algorithm_stages: pair breaking of phonons above 2*Delta into quasiparticles (G4CMPSCPairBreakingProcess/Rate, G4CMPKaplanQP)
quasiparticle recombination and phonon radiation with Kaplan rates (G4CMPQPRecombination*, G4CMPQPRadiatesPhonon*)
walk-on-spheres diffusion in the film and a time-stepped alternative (G4CMPQPDiffusion, G4CMPQPDiffusionTimeStepper*)
local trapping and film boundary handling (G4CMPQPLocalTrapping*, G4CMPQPBoundaryProcess)
polycrystalline elastic phonon scattering in films (G4CMPPhononPolycrystalElasticScattering*)
unique_responsibilities: Bogoliubov quasiparticle particle type and its processes
Superconductor utilities and Kaplan theory rates
The validation program and its macros
not_responsible_for: Bulk-crystal phonon transport (phonon module) except as the pair-breaking source
modules.differences: Quasiparticles in a superconducting film with an energy gap; diffusion rather than ballistic transport; the only module with an upstream analytic reference (Kaplan lifetimes, first-passage limits).
evidence: validation Validation_BoundaryTransmission.mac: 10,000 events 12 s, 390 MB step file, rerun byte-identical
Validation_QPPhononRadiation.mac: 59,400 of 100,000 events in 180 s (unmeasured); Validation_Comprehensive.mac: 217 of 1,000 events in 180 s (unmeasured)
every macro opens the OGL viewer; run natively with the vis lines stripped because this Geant4 has no OpenGL
phonons entering and leaving the film use the phonon module's processes; the validation macros inactivate bulk scattering and downconversion
